dedupe_keys.name: nigeria household fuel prices and estimates by geopolitical zone 2010 2024

description: This collection assembles household electricity, LPG, kerosene, firewood and charcoal prices for Nigeria’s six geopolitical zones. The research team combines National Bureau of Statistics fuel prices, electricity-regulator tariffs and published solid-fuel estimates, with inflation and exchange-rate adjustments. The article covers 2010–2024, mixing observations with reconstructed earlier values and forecasts for 2022–2024. Mendeley version 3 contains one public ZIP archive licensed CC BY 4.0 with free access; internal file formats were not inspected. Original observations cover different periods, and some electricity tariffs refer to distribution companies, not matching geopolitical boundaries. Forecasts are not subsequently observed market prices. A reviewer-assessed use is defining regional fuel-cost assumptions in household technology-choice or energy-transition simulations. model-osemosys is a related energy-planning model, although price units and time bases need harmonization before use. No archive was fetched and no forecast accuracy was evaluated.
name: Nigeria household fuel prices and estimates by geopolitical zone, 2010–2024
